lessons: Attempt 2 (codex, gpt-6.1-terra) stopped after about 6 min with an empty diff_stat and said acceptance tests were unfinished, even though the 76-test Verification run passed. Use the 30m time budget to finish every criterion 1-12 instead of stopping early.

Commit clutch/index.py, tests/unit/test_index_build.py, tests/unit/test_index_embeddings.py and tests/integration/test_index_extensions.py on the ticket branch before reporting. Uncommitted work is lost because each attempt restarts from the merge base.

Before writing tests, map each acceptance criterion 1-11 to a named test. Cover these: every embed_failed reason (exit 2, exec ExceptionClass, not json, the string/object/[]/true/NaN/1e308 replies as not a vector, length 2 != 3), temp-file fs.remove after success and after failure, and create

Criterion 7 needs a recording connection wrapper passed through connect. It counts INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements on files, chunks and embeddings, and the count must be zero on a second build over unchanged files. Criterion 9 uses the same wrapper to show the build issues no INSTALL, LOAD,

In tests/integration/test_index_extensions.py, run real-DuckDB builds a-c on a reopened database and skip with 'vss/fts extensions unavailable offline'. Add the criterion 11 ast scan of clutch/index.py. Report 'complete' only after all of these tests exist and the Verification command passes.
